newsitem.title: USA: N.J. Supreme Court orders more aid to poor schools.
newsitem.headline: N.J. Supreme Court orders more aid to poor schools.

text.p: The New Jersey Supreme Court on Wednesday ruled in favor of Gov. Christine Whitman's plan to set core curriculum standards for public schools, but ordered the administration to funnel more aid to poor districts.

Whitman said she was disappointed by the ruling. But she also said that excess revenues generated by better-than-expected tax collections would help deal with the court's mandate that an additional $248 million be spent on poor districts.
Treasurer Brian Clymer said Wednesday excess revenues for the fiscal year ending June 30 would likely be $450 million.
